label: Brightness or Colour Only
blurb: Put it after a grade to keep only part of what the grade did. Brightness only keeps the grade's light and contrast but gives back the clip's own colours, so a contrast curve stops pushing the saturation. Colour only keeps the grade's colours on the clip's own brightness, so a look or LUT cannot crush the shadows. Fade lowers the whole grade above it at once. With nothing before it, the clip passes through.
